name: GitHub Work Token
description: Bind-mounts the host ~/.github-work-token file into the container and installs it at $HOME/.github-work-token (mode 600, owned by $_REMOTE_USER) at postCreate time. Paired with dotfiles that run `gh auth login --with-token` from that file once `gh` is installed. Mount target is under /var to avoid being shadowed by /tmp tmpfs overlays (e.g., from docker-in-docker).
